name: The Steel Orphan (CR 1)
body:
The Steel Orphan CR 1

XP 400
Human bloodrager 1/champion 1
LN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 10 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16 (+5 armor, +1 Dex)
Hp 17 (1d10+2+5)
Fort +4, Ref +1, Will +1; +2 Will when in a bloodrage, +1 trait vs. fear and effect caused by dragons (Draconic Lineage)
Defensive Abilities hard to kill

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fast movement
Melee longsword +6 (1d8+3, 19—20)
Ranged shortbow +2 (1d6/x3)
Special Attacks bloodrage 7 rounds/day, 2 claws +6 (1d6+5), fleet charge, mythic power 5/day, surge +1d6, tear apart
Bloodline Draconic (steel)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 12, Con 14, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 13
Base Atk +1; CMB +4; CMD 15
Traits Draconic Destiny, Draconic Lineage
Feats Draconic Manifestation* (4 rounds/day), Weapon FocusM (longsword)
Skills Acrobatics +5, Climb +7, Knowledge (arcana) +5, Perception +5, Survival +5
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ draconic heritage
Gear bloodrager’s kit (9 gp), longsword (15 gp), scale armor (50 gp), shortbow (30 gp) with 20 arrows (1 gp)
